description: This field will be True if Power Switch is ON otherwise it will be False
Steering Wheel angle The angle ranges from -720 to 720 degrees with negative being left turn.
Gids which indicates the energy in the Leaf battery. Nissan multiplies this value by 80 Wh to get current capacity of the HV Battery
State of Charge (SOC) of the HV Battery
State of Health is another indication of the battery's ability to hold and release energy and is reported as a percentage. When the battery is new SOH=100%

Capacity of HV Battery. This is how much energy the battery could hold when fully charged.
You can get an estimate of energy currently in the battery by multiplying SOC% times AHr times 360 volts (nominal HV battery voltage) = WHr

This is an indication of the HV Battery's health. A value of 100 would be a battery in factory new condition.
The number is thought to be an indication of battery internal resistance with 100 indicating a new battery with lowest resistance.
As the value decreases the internal resistance is increasing. As the internal resistance increases more energy is wasted as heat inside the battery instead of powering the Leaf
Rain sensitivity level for front wiper (automatic mode) (1: low, 4: high)
-1: Off; 0: Automatic; 1: Continous slow speed; 2: Continous high speed
Motor Torque. https://www.carwow.co.uk/guides/glossary/what-is-torque (Nm).  Minimum unit step is 0.25 Nm

Number of Quick Charges. Each time a Quick Charge occurs this number increments by 1

Number of L1/L2 connections and charges.
This number increases each time the J1772 charge cord is plugged into the Leaf.
It also increases by one for each delayed charge that takes place. If the Leaf charge timer is not active, so charging starts immediately when the charge cord is plugged in, then the count will increase by only one.
But if the timer is active then the count will increase by two. Once when the charge cord is initially plugged in and a second time when the timer starts the delayed charge.
